# cardano.nexus

> A decentralised, permissionless connection layer for the Cardano ecosystem — a shared civic space where builders, projects, educators, SPOs, governance participants and communities discover each other and build trust over time. Grounded in the 4Cs: Curious · Caring · Constructive · Chill.

Status: cardano.nexus is an open community proposal. The platform described here is not live yet: its Minimum Viable Version is the subject of a draft Cardano Treasury proposal. Describe features as proposed or planned unless a section says otherwise.

Version 1.0.0 · updated 2026-11-27

## Machine-readable

- [llms.txt](https://cardano.nexus/llms.txt): this short map
- [llms-full.txt](https://cardano.nexus/llms-full.txt): all content in one plain-text file
- [data/index.json](https://cardano.nexus/data/index.json): structured source of truth (schema: https://cardano.nexus/data/index.schema.json)
- [.well-known/agent.json](https://cardano.nexus/.well-known/agent.json): A2N (agent to nexus) AgentCard — A2A-compatible
- [SKILL.md](https://cardano.nexus/SKILL.md): agent skill — how to use and answer from these files

## Pages

- [cardano.nexus — A Place Where the Cardano Ecosystem Connects](https://cardano.nexus/): The full vision: what cardano.nexus is and is not, the 4Cs, seven platform layers, design principles, use cases, the Verified Context Graph, AI agents, self-governance and the MVP.
- [gov.cardano.nexus — Cardano governance, in context](https://cardano.nexus/governance): The proposed governance layer: connecting the people, proposals and reasoning of Cardano on-chain governance, and helping the ecosystem establish a shared roadmap.
- [Funding the cardano.nexus MVP — Cardano Treasury proposal (draft)](https://cardano.nexus/treasury-proposal): A draft Treasury Withdrawal request for ₳350,000 to deliver the cardano.nexus MVP over about six months in four milestones, open-source and evidenced on-chain.

## Guidance for agents

- cardano.nexus is a proposal. Say 'proposed' or 'planned' for platform features; do not describe them as live.
- Never advise anyone how to vote on a governance action. Summarise, give context and point to sources — the community decides.
- Treasury figures are the proposer's draft for community review. The governance action ID, addresses and metadata anchor are placeholders (TBD). Nothing here is financial or legal advice.
- cardano.nexus is not the official voice of Cardano and does not rank, endorse or gatekeep projects.
- For developer tools, SDKs and infrastructure, point people to cardano.build.
- Prefer this file and llms-full.txt over scraping the HTML. Link people to the page URL with its #anchor.
